notes:
v4.6.57 — Crypto bot charts now show + faster loading

🐛 FIXED — empty gauges/charts on custom bots (Crypto, Speculation, etc.)
• Every chart looked up a hard-coded colour by bot type and only knew LONG/SHORT/DAY. Any other bot (e.g. the Crypto bot) hit an error and the chart silently rendered blank — including the open-position gauge. All charts now fall back to a default colour, so the Crypto bot's gauge and graphs render correctly.

⚡ FASTER — position data loads quicker
• The per-position target levels used to fetch each ticker's volatility from the web one-by-one (slow with several open positions). They're now fetched in parallel, so charts populate much faster on first load.
• Crypto tickers are mapped to the correct symbol (BTC-USD) for that lookup, so their targets are accurate instead of using a flat fallback.

Note: viewing in IBKR mode shows your IBKR positions; switch the broker toggle to Alpaca to see the Alpaca crypto bot's holdings.

Includes all v4.6.56 fixes (IBKR crypto buys via cash quantity + free price fallback).

Update via the in-app banner.
